## Appearance

Lucy is a lovely child who has long, sleek curls that are kept perfectly neat, as well as gentle, mild hazel eyes and a straight nose. She maintains an immaculate, genteel appearance, wearing a crisp, starched white dress accented by a black sash. However, she once tumbled down exterior cellar stairs, which stripped all the skin from her nose.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P32](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0032), [v3 ch.Change P33](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0033)_

## Personality

Lucy is an amiable, well-behaved, and proper individual who naturally maintains an extraordinarily calm demeanor. Known for her orderliness, she is tidy, careful, systematic, and unemotional when attending to her tasks. She is notably perceptive, sensible, cautious, and dependable, remembering her responsibilities and rarely needing instructions more than once. Though characterized by an extreme rigidity and decorum, she exhibits a helpful nature, mature grace, and a hard-working spirit. In formal company, she remains quiet unless addressed, answering modestly and conducting herself decorously.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P87](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0087), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +7 more_

## History

As a newly orphaned twin, Lucy was brought alongside her brother [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) by [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). Shortly after arriving, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) enticed her outside, tricks her into jumping into a pigpen, and leaves her drenched under a water pump before walking into an [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) meeting. Later, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) locked Lucy inside Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse, sparking a desperate search before she was found. After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returned to teaching, Lucy was terrified by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories of family ghosts, though her long-term future at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) was secured when a trust fund was established following Richard Farrow's death. She later survived a monstrous hail storm that devastated the area, sheltering safely with her family at home. Eventually, Lucy was forced by [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to skip Sunday School during a day of his rebellious behavior, though she continued to grow up at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), later attending family meals and gathering with loved ones to celebrate Nell's wedding in the orchard.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +30 more_

## Relationships

### [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lucy--robin-farrow.md)

Lucy and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) are twin siblings who were brought to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) together after becoming orphans. Lucy frequently falls victim to Robin's mischievous tricks, such as being coaxed outside into a pigpen, getting drenched under a water pump, and even being locked inside Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +21 more_

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +10 more</sub>

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lucy--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) is a relative who took Lucy and her twin brother in to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) following the death of their mother. She acts as a guardian, caring for Lucy and organizing searches whenever Robin's antics cause her to go missing.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), +6 more_

- Relative of — raised her upon mother's death  <sub>[v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P11](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0011)</sub>

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lucy--nell-harcourt.md)

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) acts as a warm, protective figure in Lucy's household at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), welcoming her and her twin brother. When Robin's pranks leave Lucy missing or locked away in a toolhouse, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) participates in the search to rescue her and helps figure out how to handle the situation.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), +6 more_

- Friend of — welcomed her home warmly with Robin (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014)</sub>
